app.name: LandVal
app.description: Accurate land pricing and marketplace for Rwanda

home.heroTitle: Accurate land valuation powered by official data
home.heroSubtitle: Connect with verified buyers — diaspora & foreign investors. Get instant pricing based on zone coefficients, title verification, and market trends.

features.title: Why choose LVS
features.heading: Built for Rwanda's land market
features.subtitle: Gazette integration, geolocation precision, and direct buyer matching.

gazette.title: Official Gazette data
gazette.desc: Location coefficients directly from Rwanda Land Authority, updated quarterly.

maps.title: Interactive parcel maps
maps.desc: Draw boundaries, measure distances, view zoning overlays.

evolution.title: Price evolution
evolution.desc: Historical trends & 5-year projection for smart investment.

matching.title: Diaspora & foreign matching
matching.desc: Connect with high‑net‑worth buyers; dedicated concierge.

features.zoneDesc: Click on the map or type your address. Our engine cross-references the Rwanda gazette zones (urban, rural, agricultural, marshland) and computes the base coefficient.

steps.title: Four steps to your land transaction
steps.step1Desc: Enter parcel ID or drop title documents
steps.step3Desc: Get introduced to serious buyers (diaspora, local)
